name: io.github.imharikumaran/altimateguide
description: Altimateguide is an independent software directory. Research tools with no account: search profiles, compare two tools side by side, find alternatives, and list live deals. With an account, submit a tool for editorial review, add a time-boxed deal, and upgrade a listing (paid is the fastest dofollow route).

environmentVariables.name: ALTIMATEGUIDE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional account API token for the write tools. Create one at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access), or mint one at runtime with the complete_login tool (email OTP). The read tools (search_tools, get_tool, compare_tools, find_alternatives, list_deals) work without it.
